contexts.text: It was found that it was monks (who had disturbed the angelic Spirits of the Sixth Earth).
The monkish Spirits were seen, namely, those who had been travelling monks, or missionaries.
(A conversation with one of these monks. His dense ignorance of the truths of faith, and his cupidity for gain and dominion, cause him to be cast into Hell.) SE 5513. a [22].
